_about: Quaternius UAL 1 + 2 (CC0) sword clips replacing the UE template's combo and charged attack on a twin-blade character. Read by scripts/anim/bake_library_clips.py with --contract <game combat-contract.json> (TheAetherWars Tools/CombatContract.py): every clip is retimed to the game's own length with its fastest sword-hand moment on the game's hit-trace time, so combo windows and damage frames do not move. The second cut is mirrored so the combo alternates right, left, right. Horizontal travel is root motion.
